blocks.x: Ad and martech businesses trade on identity, measurement and trust: signal loss (cookie deprecation, ATT), clean-room measurement and consent architecture decide whether targeting survives the privacy era, and whether spend proves incrementality. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.
The ground truth of this sector

The work concentrates in identity resolution, audience activation, measurement/incrementality, with creative operations close behind. The paths are busy; the decisions are late. Closing that delay is worth more than any single tool purchase.
Advertising & MarTech: named from the floor, not from a framework,

items: Third-party identifiers deprecate; first-party identity graphs inconsistent across systems.
Invalid traffic and fraud schemes persist; measurement unverified.
CDP/activation stacks duplicate data; costs rise with fragmentation.
Attribution wars persist; incrementality rarely tested.
